en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a large wooden-and-masonry mountain inn or lookout building standing on a forested hillside. The multi-story structure has a wraparound balcony, a central gabled roof section, and a square tower. Sparse tall trees surround the building, and a picket fence encloses the property. Printed red text at the top names the site and its elevation; a vertical imprint on the right margin credits the printer and the year 1906.
